change_summaries.mue_units_v1__mue_units_v2: The 2025 revision of Payment Policy PP-1042 lowers the Medically Unlikely Edit (MUE) unit ceiling for CPT 11200 from 15 units to 10 units per date of service, and adds a requirement that providers billing above the limit submit supporting documentation for manual clinical review. Operational impact: the tighter limit will flag additional claim lines that previously passed (any 11200 line billed at 11-15 units), increasing review volume but also increasing potential overpayment recovery.
